description: Fetch new transcript events from an open Voice Bridge call since the last cursor. Returns partial + final transcripts + system events. Pass waitMs (e.g. 20000) to hold the call until the callee has FINISHED TALKING (a final transcript, then 0.7 s of silence) or the call changes state, then get everything at once: no polling timer, and you do not answer in the middle of their sentence. Without waitMs, poll in a loop (~500ms-1s) and decide yourself when they are done. No additional payment.

cursor.description: Last seq number seen (default 0 = start from beginning)

quietMs.description: Optional, used with waitMs. How many milliseconds of silence after a final transcript count as 'finished talking' (0-5000, default 700). 0 = return at the first final transcript, even mid-sentence.

waitMs.description: Optional. Hold the call up to this many milliseconds (max 25000) until the callee has finished talking: a FINAL transcript has arrived and nothing new for quietMs, or a system event arrives. Then everything since the cursor is returned at once. Partial transcripts alone do not end the wait. Default 0 = return immediately.

name: poll_voice_bridge
